lessons.title: Exploring Transformations
lessons.goal: Describe the effects of $a,k,d,c$ in $y=af(k(x-d))+c$, including reciprocal horizontal scale factors and reflections. Factor the inside expression before reading the horizontal shift.
notes: $(x,y)\mapsto(x/k+d,ay+c)$, with $k\ne0$. Horizontal distances scale by $1/|k|$.
For $f(2x-6)=f(2(x-3))$, the shift is right 3, not right 6. Negative $a$ reflects vertically; negative $k$ reflects horizontally.
Some videos write $g(x)=af(b(x-c))+d$. Their $b,c,d$ are this course's $k,d,c$; the mathematics and coordinate mapping are the same.
